caption:
The AI fear keeping you up at night isn't really about technology. It's about worth — the question of whether you were ever truly needed, or just available. That question existed before AI gave it a deadline. The Worth Audit separates identity from function. DM "DETOX" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this for the next 2am spiral about your career.

#selfworth #existential #overthinking #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: you're not afraid AI will take your job. you're afraid you were already replaceable.
